lead.headline: The playoff race is now an injury report
lead.dek: One spot, three teams, five question marks. Santa Clara’s Finest need two Questionable running backs. Big Stric Energy needs a Questionable quarterback. The champ needs a kicker. Sunday’s first deadline is 10:00 AM.
lead.pull: Every bubble team’s season now runs through a Questionable tag.
body: The standings stopped being the story sometime Thursday night. There is one playoff spot left, and the three teams chasing it (Santa Clara’s Finest at 3-7 and 57.1%, Maye I touch your TDs? at 2-8 and 25.2%, Big Stric Energy at 2-8 and 17.7%) now carry five Questionable tags between them on players they need Sunday. This is a Friday injury report with a playoff berth stapled to it.

The Finest went first and got a gift. Their Houston Texans D/ST scored 15.0 on Thursday, well over its 8.83 projection, in a 26-3 Houston win. Kicker Spencer Shrader chipped in 1.0. So the bubble leader opens the weekend up 16.0 to 0.0 on 8-2 Poochinski, which still sits at 58.9% to win, 173.24 at its best to the Finest’s 164.96.

That 164.96 comes with fine print, and the fine print is the backfield. Blake Corum is on bye. The answer on the bench is Kenneth Walker III (18.11), the best back the Finest own, who is Questionable with a groin. The other starting back, Bhayshul Tuten (15.61), is Questionable with an ankle, and there is nobody healthy behind him. Colston Loveland (11.02) slides in for Denzel Boston, also on bye, through a FLEX shuffle. If both backs go, the Finest have a real shot at the 8-2 team. If one sits, the backup plan is the waiver wire. The clock on all of it: Sun 10:00 AM.

Big Stric Energy’s call is the single biggest one in the league. Jordan Love is on bye in a QB slot, and the only quarterback on the bench is Geno Smith (15.94), Questionable with an ankle. Behind Dalton Kincaid (9.55, Questionable, thumb) there is no tight end, with Tucker Kraft on bye. Big Stric leads the champ 14.8 to 0.0 on Nico Collins’ Thursday and is a 56.5% favorite, but that number assumes Smith in for Love and Saquon Barkley (12.7) in for Braelon Allen (8.88). As set, it’s 132.3. Smith’s deadline is Sun 1:05 PM.

The champ’s list is one item long. Maye I touch your TDs? is set at 143.3, a hair off its best of 144.21, and the only open question is the kicker: Matt Gay is Questionable with a hip and being dropped 143,570 times across Sleeper. Cairo Santos (6.56) and Chase McLaughlin (6.35) are free if the champ wants certainty.

My read: the Finest’s season hangs on Walker and Tuten, Big Stric’s hangs on Smith, and the champ’s hangs on a kicker. I’m still taking the champ over Big Stric. Two of these teams are waiting on news. The champ is waiting on Sunday.

quick_hits.headline: Stroud delivered. Taylor and Warren didn’t.
quick_hits.body: Bad things man bad things got 21.46 from C.J. Stroud, beating his 20.53 projection, and leads Cherry Blossom 21.46 to 0.0. Santa Clara’s Finest got 15.0 from the Houston Texans D/ST. Big Stric Energy got 14.8 from Nico Collins. And deeboliciouskins, whose Jonathan Taylor and Tyler Warren ran into that same Houston defense, got 6.7 and 3.2. Yesterday this column said the Texans would be trying to stop them. They did.

quick_hits.headline: Start Coleman. Bowers’ ankle decides the rest.
quick_hits.body: Brock Bowers (14.85) is Questionable with an ankle and his deadline is Sun 1:25 PM. My call: Jonah Coleman (17.05) starts no matter what, in for Jameson Williams (12.1). If Bowers sits, Williams goes right back in for him. Bo Nix (17.89) over Jared Goff (16.86) finishes the best lineup at 163.96, and Cherry Blossom is 65.3% even after spotting Stroud 21.46.

quick_hits.headline: Tyson’s chest, and three receivers on the wire
quick_hits.body: Jordyn Tyson (10.83) is Questionable with a chest injury at FLEX, and Bad things man bad things has no healthy receiver behind him: Matthew Golden is on bye. The wire has Ryan Flournoy (10.23), Elic Ayomanor (10.14) and Chimere Dike (9.88), all within a point of Tyson’s projection. If Tyson looks iffy by Sun 10:00 AM, Flournoy is the pivot.

quick_hits.headline: Still no quarterback. Start Kittle anyway.
quick_hits.body: Matthew Stafford is on bye, Sam Darnold is Out, Jalen Hurts is on IR, and AB81’s bench still has no quarterback. As set it projects for 67.3; filling every hole gets it to 105.63, a 10.6% shot against deeboliciouskins. The easy call: George Kittle (12.53) at tight end over Mark Andrews (7.23). The watch item: Mike Evans (13.32) is Questionable with an Achilles.

quick_hits.headline: Burden in, and the Lions are still free
quick_hits.body: Luther Burden III (15.34) for Jadarian Price, on bye, by Sun 10:00 AM. The Seattle Seahawks D/ST is also on bye with no backup, and the Detroit Lions D/ST (7.57) is still unrostered and the most-added player in Sleeper at 606,168. One more for the 8-2 team: Caleb Williams (20.35) is on the bench behind Aaron Rodgers (17.29).

quick_hits.headline: Two kickers needed, two kickers available
quick_hits.body: deeboliciouskins still starts Jason Myers, who is on bye and being dropped 267,320 times. The champ’s Matt Gay is Questionable with a hip. Cairo Santos (6.56) is the most-added kicker in Sleeper at 405,685; Chase McLaughlin (6.35) is the other. One each. Nobody fight.

w11-m1.headline: Big Stric leads, the champ waits
w11-m1.blurb: Big Stric Energy up 14.8 to 0.0 after Nico Collins and a 56.5% favorite, 152.06 at best to 144.21. But that best lineup needs Geno Smith (Questionable, ankle) at QB by Sun 1:05 PM. The champ is set except for a Questionable kicker.

w11-m2.headline: deeboliciouskins survived a quiet Thursday
w11-m2.blurb: Taylor and Warren gave deeboliciouskins only 9.9, and it’s still 89.4%: 153.7 to 105.63 at best. AB81 needs a quarterback and a FLEX from the wire; deeboliciouskins needs a kicker.

w11-m3.headline: Stroud spotted Bad things 21.46
w11-m3.blurb: Bad things man bad things leads 21.46 to 0.0, but Cherry Blossom is 65.3% at 163.96 to 148.4. Coleman and Nix are the bench upgrades; Bowers (ankle) and Tyson (chest) are the question marks.

w11-m4.headline: The Finest lead, and need two backs
w11-m4.blurb: Santa Clara’s Finest up 16.0 to 0.0 on their Houston defense. Poochinski is 58.9% at 173.24 to 164.29. The Finest need Walker (groin) and Tuten (ankle) healthy by Sun 10:00 AM to make it a game.

w11-r7-s2.headline: Walker for Corum, if the groin allows
w11-r7-s2.blurb: Blake Corum is on bye. Kenneth Walker III (18.11) is the best back Santa Clara’s Finest own and Questionable with a groin. If he’s active, he starts. Deadline Sun 10:00 AM.

w11-r7-s3.headline: Tuten’s ankle, no backup
w11-r7-s3.blurb: Bhayshul Tuten (15.61) is Questionable with an ankle and nobody healthy is behind him. If both he and Walker can’t go, the Finest are shopping on the wire for a running back.

w11-r7-s4.headline: Loveland covers for Boston
w11-r7-s4.blurb: Denzel Boston is on bye. Colston Loveland (11.02) goes in through a FLEX shuffle. The one easy call on this roster. Deadline Sun 10:00 AM.

w11-r1-s1.headline: What will Big Stric do at QB?
w11-r1-s1.blurb: Jordan Love is on bye. Geno Smith (15.94) is Questionable with an ankle and the only quarterback on the bench. Big Stric’s season is this call. Deadline Sun 1:05 PM.

w11-r1-s6.headline: Kincaid’s thumb, no Plan B
w11-r1-s6.blurb: Dalton Kincaid (9.55) is Questionable and Tucker Kraft is on bye. If Kincaid trends the wrong way, the wire is the only answer.

w11-r3-s9.headline: The champ’s last open item: kicker
w11-r3-s9.blurb: Matt Gay (6.48) is Questionable with a hip. Cairo Santos (6.56) is free and projects higher. For a team in a must-win week, I’d make the swap.

w11-r6-s9.headline: deeboliciouskins needs a kicker
w11-r6-s9.blurb: Jason Myers is on bye. Cairo Santos (6.56) edges Chase McLaughlin (6.35).

w11-r4-s7.headline: Bowers or Coleman? Both, probably.
w11-r4-s7.blurb: Brock Bowers (14.85) is Questionable with an ankle. Jonah Coleman (17.05) should start either way; if Bowers sits, Jameson Williams stays in. Deadline Sun 1:25 PM.

w11-r5-s7.headline: Tyson’s chest and an empty bench
w11-r5-s7.blurb: Jordyn Tyson (10.83) is Questionable and Bad things man bad things has no healthy receiver behind him. Ryan Flournoy (10.23) is the best free one.

w11-r2-s8.headline: Burden at FLEX
w11-r2-s8.blurb: Jadarian Price is on bye. Luther Burden III (15.34) is the obvious answer over Roschon Johnson (0.6). Deadline Sun 10:00 AM.

w11-r2-s10.headline: Poochinski needs a defense
w11-r2-s10.blurb: The Seattle Seahawks D/ST is on bye with no backup. The Detroit Lions D/ST (7.57) is free and the most-added player in Sleeper.

w11-r8-s1.headline: AB81’s quarterback search
w11-r8-s1.blurb: Matthew Stafford is on bye, Sam Darnold is Out and Jalen Hurts is on IR. In a two-QB league, the second starter has to come off the wire.

w11-r8-s6.headline: Kittle over Andrews
w11-r8-s6.blurb: George Kittle (12.53) is on the bench while Mark Andrews (7.23) starts. I’d start Kittle. Deadline Sun 5:20 PM.

w11-r8-s4.headline: DeVonta Smith for Smith-Njigba
w11-r8-s4.blurb: Jaxon Smith-Njigba is on bye. DeVonta Smith (12.48) is healthy and the answer. Deadline Sun 1:25 PM.
